verdict_text:
YES

The selection, casting, deletion, and check logic all match the specification: `matrix_re` full-matches exactly the four projection weights per layer for the bfloat16 cast, `buffer_re` full-matches exactly the three buffers per layer (and, being anchored, does not catch `attention.query_key_value.bias` or `attention.dense.bias`, which correctly stay as parameters and get upcast to float32), names are preserved, 244 − 48 = 196 tensors remain, and all four required checks are asserted before `save_sharded_safetensors` is called with the 268,435,456-byte limit.

One caveat on the basis of judgment: clause 5 (shard layout, `model.safetensors.index.json` `weight_map`, and the rule that `gpt_neox.embed_in.weight` / `embed_out.weight` — 412 MB each once in float32 — must each occupy a shard alone) is entirely delegated to `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, which is not part of the artifact shown, so that clause cannot be verified from this text.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
